headers.merge_trace:
(bank : StoredOriginalWeightLookup.Bank) (xs ys acc : List StoredEdges.Edge) :
    Trace (transition bank) (work bank xs ys) (.merge xs ys acc)
      (.reverse ((List.merge xs ys (StoredWeightComparison.result bank)).reverse++acc) [])

headers.work_le:
(bank : StoredOriginalWeightLookup.Bank) (xs ys : List StoredEdges.Edge) :
    work bank xs ys≤(xs.length+ys.length)*(2*bank.length+8)+2
headers.full_trace:
(bank : StoredOriginalWeightLookup.Bank) (xs ys : List StoredEdges.Edge) :
    ∃ k,k≤bound bank xs ys ∧ Trace (transition bank) k (.merge xs ys [])
      (.halt (List.merge xs ys (StoredWeightComparison.result bank)))
headers.execute_eq:
(bank : StoredOriginalWeightLookup.Bank) (xs ys : List StoredEdges.Edge) :
    execute bank xs ys=List.merge xs ys (StoredWeightComparison.result bank)
